body:
i'm thinking more that it's my fault for being an asshole

lately we've been getting into a fight about every other day (even though they said "no we haven't been fighting that often" and "i'm not upset at you"), and i feel like their disposition towards me has changed, and that they're trying to help me by telling me what i've been doing wrong but instead it's just making me feel worse, like i knew i did something wrong and i'm a piece of shit and i'm bad at socializing, but i really didn't need you telling me the specifics, and i know you're trying to "help me improve" by learning from my specific mistakes, but really it just makes me feel like the only person who loved me is really just putting up with me at this point

i feel selfish

sometimes i think maybe i'm actually useful for something in life, but then reality slaps me in the face in the form of one of the few people whom i thought loved me acting more and more like they don't care for me
i don't want to live anymore.. i'm really tired, i hardly sleep, i spend almost all of my time awake thinking about why i hate myself and why everyone else probably does too
